title: MxAgile Context Epoch
description: Durable, versioned resume contract for MxAgile Context Lifecycle. A Context Epoch is one continuous agent-session segment within a longer mission. Multiple epochs can span a single mission without carrying the full historical conversation into every subsequent context. CANONICAL FILE: planning/lifecycle/context-epoch.yaml (Git-tracked). LOCAL SCRATCH: .concord/scratch/context-epoch.yaml (gitignored, session cache). NEVER store credentials, tokens, passwords, or sensitive environment values in this file. See .mxagile/policies/context-lifecycle.md.

schema_version.description: Schema version for forward-compatibility detection. Increment minor for additive changes, major for breaking changes.

verified.description: Claims that have been positively verified with durable evidence.

failed.description: Claims that were evaluated and failed verification.

unverified.description: Claims that could not be verified (unavailable evidence, blocked precondition, etc.). Unavailable verification is NEVER equivalent to passed verification.

decisions.description: Key architectural or scope decisions recorded during this mission.

open_gates.description: Gates that must pass before the mission or current lifecycle phase can continue.

user_overrides.description: Explicit user instructions that override default framework behavior. These are preserved across epochs.

artifacts.description: Key artifacts produced or consumed in this mission. References only — no raw content.

mission.description: Mission identity and high-level status. A mission may span multiple Context Epochs.

objective.description: Human-readable mission goal. Concise — one sentence.

started.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the mission started.

wave.description: MxAgile wave this mission is executing within, e.g. W01.

scope.description: Scope boundaries of the mission. Changes require an explicit user override.

company_layer.description: Company Layer identifier (if any), e.g. mercedes-layer.

project.description: Consumer project root path or identifier.

exclusions.description: Paths or identifiers explicitly excluded from this mission's scope.

lifecycle.description: Current position in the MxAgile lifecycle.

current_phase.description: Current MxAgile lifecycle phase. Must match lifecycle.yaml phases.

last_completed_checkpoint.description: Identifier or description of the last completed checkpoint, e.g. 'W01-gate-to-ready-passed'.

active_context_epoch.description: Current epoch identifier, e.g. EPOCH-001. Increments on every Context Epoch rollover.

interrupted.description: True if the mission is in an interrupted state awaiting re-sync.

interruption_class.description: Class of the active interruption. See policies/lifecycle-resync.md for semantics.

interruption_reason.description: Human-readable reason for the current interruption, if any.

checkpoint_ref.description: Path to the checkpoint file created at rollover, if any.

previous_epochs.description: Ordered history of prior Context Epochs for this mission.

repository_state.description: Repository snapshot at the time this checkpoint was written. Used for re-synchronization staleness detection.

repository_identity.description: Remote origin URL or unique identifier. Used to detect cross-repo re-sync errors.

branch.description: Git branch name at checkpoint time.

commit.description: Short or full git commit hash at checkpoint time.

working_tree_state.description: Whether the working tree had uncommitted changes at checkpoint time.

relevant_paths.description: Key paths that were active or modified during this epoch (relative to project root).

checkpoint_time.description: ISO datetime when this checkpoint was written.

evidence_state.description: Evidence lifecycle state. VERIFIED=positively confirmed. FAILED=confirmed failed. UNVERIFIED=not yet checked or evidence unavailable (NOT equivalent to passed). STALE=previously VERIFIED but subsequent repository/runtime change may have invalidated it. SUPERSEDED=replaced by newer evidence.

verified_claim.description: A claim that passed verification with recorded evidence. evidence_state MUST be VERIFIED.

claim.description: Human-readable claim, e.g. 'Gate-to-refinement passed for W01'.

evidence_reference.description: Path or identifier pointing to durable evidence (never inline raw output).

verification_method.description: How verification was performed, e.g. 'gate-to-refinement skill'.

verification_time_or_sequence.description: ISO datetime or sequence number of verification.

validity_scope.description: Scope for which this verification is valid, e.g. 'W01 implementing phase'.

stale_if_commit_changes.description: If true, this claim becomes STALE when the repository commit changes.

failed_claim.description: A claim that was verified and failed. evidence_state MUST be FAILED.

failure_summary.description: Brief description of why the claim failed.

unverified_claim.description: A claim where verification was not possible. UNVERIFIED is NEVER equivalent to VERIFIED. Preserving this state across rollover is mandatory.

reason.description: Why this claim could not be verified.

required_verification.description: What would be needed to verify this claim.

blocking_or_non_blocking.description: Whether this unverified claim blocks the mission from continuing.

decision.description: An architectural or scope decision recorded during the mission.
The decision itself, in one sentence.

affected_scope.description: What scope or artifact this decision affects.

supersedes.description: Prior decision this supersedes, if any.

recorded.description: ISO date when this decision was recorded.

open_gate.description: A gate that must be evaluated before the mission or phase can progress.

required_evidence.description: What evidence is needed to evaluate this gate.

user_override.description: An explicit user instruction that overrides default framework behavior. Preserved across epochs.

instruction.description: The user instruction verbatim or as precise paraphrase.

applicable_scope.description: What scope this override applies to.

still_active.description: True if this override is still in effect. Set to false when superseded or withdrawn.

recorded.description: ISO datetime when this override was issued.

artifact_ref.description: Reference to a key artifact produced or consumed during this mission. No raw content is stored here.

path_or_reference.description: Relative path or external reference URL.

integrity_metadata.description: Optional integrity metadata for the artifact. No secrets.

sha256_prefix.description: First 8 chars of SHA-256 hash for quick integrity check.

next_action.description: The next safe action to take when resuming this mission from a checkpoint.

description.description: Human-readable description of the next action.

prerequisites.description: Conditions that must be true before this action can be performed.

safe_to_run.description: True if the action can be started without additional human confirmation.

checklist_item.description: If resuming an implementing phase, the specific checklist item ID to resume from.

context_meta.description: Context management metadata for this epoch. Drives rollover recommendations.

pressure_state.description: Current context pressure level. UNKNOWN: no reliable token measurement available — cannot authorize or suppress rollover decisions (default when no harness/gateway measurement is present). NORMAL: reliable measurement exists and is below the configured pressure threshold. PRESSURE: approaching threshold. ROLLOVER_RECOMMENDED: checkpoint available, rollover advisable. ROLLOVER_REQUIRED: must roll over at next safe boundary. Threshold values are in .mxagile/config.yaml context_lifecycle.pressure_thresholds.

source_checkpoint.description: Path to the checkpoint file this epoch was resumed from, if any.

estimated_context_tokens.description: Externally supplied context size estimate in tokens. Do not compute locally — accept only from harness or gateway measurement.

context_token_source.description: How the context size was measured. Absent or 'unknown' means no reliable measurement.

hot_context_summary.description: Brief (1-3 sentence) summary of HOT context for this epoch — user goal, active phase, next action. Must not contain COLD evidence.

epoch_started.description: ISO datetime when this epoch started.

rollover_state.description: Current rollover lifecycle state. 'not_applicable': no rollover in progress or considered. 'rollover_recommended': pressure or boundary suggests rollover. 'rollover_pending_safe_boundary': rollover approved but waiting for a safe lifecycle boundary. 'rollover_ready': all preconditions met, checkpoint valid, transition can proceed. 'rollover_performed': rollover completed, this is the post-rollover epoch. 'rollover_blocked': rollover requested but preconditions not met (unsafe operation active, checkpoint invalid, etc.). 'rollover_unsupported_by_harness': harness cannot execute context transition.

rollover_blocked_reasons.description: When rollover_state is 'rollover_blocked', lists the specific conditions preventing rollover.

feature_controls_at_checkpoint.description: Snapshot of feature control state at the time this checkpoint was written. Allows detection of configuration drift after rollover.
